hooks.command:
jq -c '(.tool_input.command // "") as $c
| ($ENV.ISSUE // "") as $n
| ($c | gsub("\"(?<d>[^\"]*)\"|\u0027(?<s>[^\u0027]*)\u0027"; ((.d // .s // "") as $q | if ($q | test("^[\\w./=:@-]+$")) then $q else "\"\"" end))) as $head
| if ($head | test("(^|[;&|(\n])[[:space:]]*git[[:space:]]+grep[[:space:]]+([^\n;&|]*[[:space:]\"])?(-[^-[:space:]]*O|--op)")) then
    {hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", permissionDecision: "deny", permissionDecisionReason: "Do not use git grep -O or --open-files-in-pager: it runs a command on each file."}}
  elif ($head | test("gh[[:space:]]+issue[[:space:]]+edit([[:space:]]|$)")) | not then empty
  else
    ($c | rtrimstr("\n") | split("\n")) as $lines
    | if $n != ""
        and $lines[0] == "gh issue edit " + $n + " --body-file - <<\u0027EOF\u0027"
        and ($lines | length) > 2
        and $lines[-1] == "EOF"
        and ($lines[1:-1] | map(select(. == "EOF")) | length) == 0
        and ($lines[1:-1] | map(select(test("^[[:space:]]*$") | not)) | length) > 0
      then empty
      else {hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", permissionDecision: "deny", permissionDecisionReason: ("Edit only issue #" + (if $n == "" then "?" else $n end) + ", as gh issue edit " + (if $n == "" then "<n>" else $n end) + " --body-file - <<\u0027EOF\u0027, the whole body on the lines after it, then a line EOF, and nothing else in the call.")}}
      end
  end'
